item.description:
🔵 Polymarket launches AI compute prediction markets

Traders can now bet on 🟩 Nvidia H100, B200 and B300 GPU rental prices through 2028. Volume tops $4M in the first three days.

The launch comes as Arthur Hayes' 🪙 FLOP Network opens its incentivized testnet, rewarding GPU owners with an airdrop for running AI models.

FLOP testnet: key facts
• Length: up to 90 days
• Scoring: not started yet
• Airdrop: 3.6B FLOP (~20%)
• No token sale, no VCs
• Mining: any GPU, 16 GB+
• Miners: 25% unlocked at launch
• Validators: 1,000 × 1.2M FLOP
• Mainnet and token: Q1 2027

Will FLOP push GPU rent higher?
